analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 36.5 entering oversold territory, with 5-day low exceeding 20-day low forming a nascent Higher Low pattern. A buy entry requires increased volume and RSI recovery above 40. A sell entry needs confirmation of the 2254.7 swing support breach.
